title: JFK and Donald Menzel's clearances
summary: Jesse Michels tells of JFK and Donald Menzel's clearances, about 1930s-1960s at Harvard, Cambridge, Massachusetts, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Well, you know, JFK was also extremely interested in astrophysics at Harvard and was close with Don Menzel, who was this famous UFO debunker, but who admitted to JFK that he held some of the deepest, you know, clearances across the board, CIA, NSA, and Navy.
Menzel happened to hold extremely high clearances at the NSA, CIA, and Navy.
tellings.difference: Leaves out JFK and the claim that Menzel admitted the clearances to him.
tellings.link_reason: Same claim: Donald Menzel held very high clearances at the NSA, CIA and Navy.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that John F. Kennedy, the future US president, was deeply interested in the study of stars and space while at Harvard University, and was close to Donald Menzel, a Harvard astronomer famous for dismissing UFO reports. According to Michels, Menzel admitted to Kennedy that he held some of the highest secret clearances across the CIA, the National Security Agency and the Navy. If true, it would mean the best-known public UFO skeptic was also deeply inside the secret world.
